sentences.text: MAN: Sandra, I seem to remember you had some family visitors staying with you recently
sentences.zh: MAN: 桑德拉，我记得你最近好像有家人来拜访并住在你那儿。

sentences.text: WOMAN: Yeah that right.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是的，没错。

sentences.text: My brother and his family were here a couple of months ago
sentences.zh: 我哥哥和他的家人几个月前来过这里。

sentences.text: MAN: OK, good.
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的，很好。

sentences.text: Well, I wanted to ask for your advice.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想向你请教一下。

sentences.text: I got my cousin and her family visiting next month and as I don't have kids, I've no idea where to take them.
sentences.zh: 下个月我表姐和她的家人要来拜访，而我又没有孩子，所以完全不知道该带他们去哪儿。

sentences.text: WOMAN: Right.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 明白了。

sentences.text: What about accommodation?
sentences.zh: 那住宿方面呢？

sentences.text: Are they going to stay with you in your flat?
sentences.zh: 他们打算住在你的公寓里吗？

sentences.text: MAN: No, thankfully.
sentences.zh: MAN: 不，谢天谢地，不会住在我那儿。

sentences.text: There wouldn't be room.
sentences.zh: 那儿根本没地方住。

sentences.text: My cousin wants me to recommend a hotel.
sentences.zh: 我表姐让我帮她推荐一家酒店。

sentences.text: Do you know anywhere?
sentences.zh: 你知道有什么合适的地方吗？

sentences.text: WOMAN: Yes, I do actually.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是的，我确实知道。

sentences.text: I always recommend people stay at the King's Hotel.
sentences.zh: 我通常都会推荐大家入住国王酒店。

sentences.text: MAN: Where's that near?
sentences.zh: MAN: 那家酒店在哪儿附近？

sentences.text: WOMAN: It's about a five minutes walk from Murray Station, so nice and central.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 它离默里车站步行大约五分钟，位置非常中心。

sentences.text: It's actually on George Street.
sentences.zh: 实际上就在乔治街上。

sentences.text: MAN: Oh yes, I know.
sentences.zh: MAN: 哦，是的，我知道那家。

sentences.text: WOMAN: I think they're on quite a tight budget, so how much roughly is it to stay there?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 我觉得他们的预算比较紧张，所以住那儿大概要多少钱？

sentences.text: If you book a family room, it's about £125 per night.
sentences.zh: 如果您预订家庭房，每晚大约125英镑。

sentences.text: My brother paid for two double rooms in the end, and I think that was around £95 for each room.
sentences.zh: 我哥哥最终支付了两间双人房的费用，我想每间房大约95英镑。

sentences.text: MAN: Oh, that's not too bad.
sentences.zh: MAN: 哦，那还不算太差。

sentences.text: WOMAN: So how old are your cousins' kids?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那么您表兄弟的孩子多大了？

sentences.text: MAN: Twelve and nine.
sentences.zh: MAN: 十二岁和九岁。

sentences.text: So I want to organise some trips while they're here.
sentences.zh: 所以我想在他们逗留期间安排一些游览活动。

sentences.text: I was thinking of doing a bus tour of the city centre, as none of them have been here before.
sentences.zh: 我考虑安排一次市中心的巴士观光游，因为他们都没来过这里。

sentences.text: WOMAN: Those bus tours are quite expensive.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那些巴士观光游相当昂贵。

sentences.text: I think it's better to do a walking tour.
sentences.zh: 我觉得步行观光游更好。

sentences.text: It gives you a much better feel for the city.
sentences.zh: 它能让您更真切地感受这座城市。

sentences.text: There's one that starts from Colton Square.
sentences.zh: 有一条线路从科尔顿广场出发。

sentences.text: It takes a couple of hours and doesn't cost that much.
sentences.zh: 全程耗时几个小时，而且花费也不高。

sentences.text: MAN: Sounds good.
sentences.zh: MAN: 听起来不错。

sentences.text: I'll look that up.
sentences.zh: 我这就去查一下。

sentences.text: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.text: WOMAN: If the weather's nice, one thing you could do is visit the old fort.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 如果天气好，您可以去参观那座古老的堡垒。

sentences.text: You could get there by boat.
sentences.zh: 您可以乘船前往。

sentences.text: The whole trip takes half a day.
sentences.zh: 整个行程耗时半天。

sentences.text: MAN: That's a really good idea.
sentences.zh: MAN: 这真是个好主意。

sentences.text: I'd like to do that myself.
sentences.zh: 我自己也很想去。

sentences.text: And if the weather bad I was thinking they could go to the science museum.
sentences.zh: 而且如果天气不好，我考虑让他们去科学博物馆。

sentences.text: But maybe they could do that when I at work
sentences.zh: 但也许他们可以在我上班的时候去那里。

sentences.text: WOMAN: Yeah don forget it closed on Mondays
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是啊，别忘了它每周一闭馆。

sentences.text: MAN: They here from Saturday for four nights so Tuesday would be best I think
sentences.zh: MAN: 他们从周六起在这里住四晚，所以我觉得周二最合适。

sentences.text: WOMAN: And it won't be so crowded then.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那时候人也不会那么拥挤。

sentences.text: Saturdays are terrible.
sentences.zh: 周六人特别多，很糟糕。

sentences.text: I took my kids to the exhibition on old computers there and it was far too crowded.
sentences.zh: 我带我的孩子们去那儿看了老式计算机展览，结果人太多，太拥挤了。

sentences.text: I wanted to go back but it's finished now.
sentences.zh: 我想再去一次，但展览现在已经结束了。

sentences.text: MAN: That's a shame.
sentences.zh: MAN: 真遗憾。

sentences.text: My cousin's kids would have enjoyed that.
sentences.zh: 我表兄的孩子们肯定会喜欢那个展览。

sentences.text: WOMAN: There's another one starting soon on space, which looks really good too.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 还有一个关于太空的新展览很快就要开始了，看起来也很棒。

sentences.text: MAN: OK, well, I'll mention that to my cousin.
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的，那我会把这个告诉我的表兄。

sentences.text: WOMAN: Have you thought about where to take them to eat?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 你考虑过带他们去哪儿吃饭了吗？

sentences.text: MAN: Well, I really like all the food stalls at Clacton Market.
sentences.zh: MAN: 嗯，我特别喜欢克拉克顿市场里的所有美食摊位。

sentences.text: My cousin's vegetarian.
sentences.zh: 我表兄是素食者。

sentences.text: I know it's one of the best places for that kind of food.
sentences.zh: 我知道那里是这类食物的最佳地点之一。

sentences.text: WOMAN: Definitely, and there'll be loads of choices for the kids too.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 没错，而且孩子们也会有很多选择。

sentences.text: You need to get there quite early, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，你得早点到那儿。

sentences.text: At the weekend, most of the stores stop serving lunch at 2.30.
sentences.zh: 周末时，大多数店铺在下午2:30就停止供应午餐了。

sentences.text: MAN: Good point.
sentences.zh: MAN: 说得对。

sentences.text: It's all going to need careful planning.
sentences.zh: 这一切都需要精心规划。

sentences.text: My cousin said she'd love to take the kids to a show at the theatre, but tickets are so expensive.
sentences.zh: 我表姐说她很乐意带孩子们去剧院看演出，但门票太贵了。

sentences.text: WOMAN: I know.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 我知道。

sentences.text: But you can get some good deals if you book online with bargained tickets for the following day.
sentences.zh: 但如果你在网上预订‘议价票’（即次日优惠票），就能拿到一些不错的折扣。

sentences.text: On some seats there a 75 discount
sentences.zh: 部分座位可享七五折优惠。

sentences.text: MAN: Really.
sentences.zh: MAN: 真的吗？

sentences.text: I must try and get some
sentences.zh: 我得赶紧订几张。

sentences.text: WOMAN: Yeah There are lots of things you can do for free as well.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是啊，还有很多免费活动可以参加。

sentences.text: No need to spend a fortune.
sentences.zh: 完全不必花一大笔钱。

sentences.text: MAN: Like what?
sentences.zh: MAN: 比如哪些？

sentences.text: WOMAN: They're coming next month, right?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 他们下个月来，对吧？

sentences.text: Well, check and see if it's the same weekend as the Roots Music Festival in Blakewell Gardens.
sentences.zh: 那你可以查一下，是否和布莱克韦尔花园举办的‘根源音乐节’在同一个周末。

sentences.text: MAN: R-O-O-T-S?
sentences.zh: MAN: R-O-O-T-S？

sentences.text: WOMAN: Yeah, check it out online.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 对，上网查一下详情。

sentences.text: It's always a family-friendly event and there's no entry charge.
sentences.zh: 这向来是一场适合全家参与的活动，而且免收入场费。

sentences.text: MAN: That sounds perfect.
sentences.zh: MAN: 听起来太完美了。

sentences.text: WOMAN: And if you're in Blakewell Gardens, climb Telegraph Hill.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 还有，如果你去了布莱克韦尔花园，就去爬电报山吧。

sentences.text: You'll be able to look right down on the port.
sentences.zh: 你就能俯瞰整个港口。

sentences.text: Everyone's always really impressed because it's so huge.
sentences.zh: 大家总是惊叹不已，因为港口规模实在太大了。

sentences.text: MAN: Oh yeah, I've been meaning to do that for ages.
sentences.zh: MAN: 哦，是啊，我早就想爬那儿了，一直拖到现在。

sentences.text: I've heard the view's amazing.
sentences.zh: 我听说那里的景色棒极了。

sentences.text: WOMAN: Yeah, it's really worth the effort.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是啊，真的值得一去。

sentences.text: MAN: Well, that's given me loads of ideas.
sentences.zh: MAN: 哇，这给了我很多灵感。

sentences.text: Thanks so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.text: Good morning and welcome to City Football Club.
sentences.zh: 早上好，欢迎来到城市足球俱乐部。

sentences.text: I'd like to give you some useful information about your visit to the stadium today and then we'll start the tour of the areas of the stadium that are open to visitors.
sentences.zh: 我想向大家介绍一些关于今天参观体育场的有用信息，然后我们将开始参观对游客开放的体育场区域。

sentences.text: I can see lots of children here today, so just to let mums and dads know a few things before we start.
sentences.zh: 我看到今天这里有很多孩子，所以先向各位家长说明几件事。

sentences.text: The stadium has lots of stairs and the players' tunnel is very dark.
sentences.zh: 体育场内有很多楼梯，球员通道也非常昏暗。

sentences.text: Please don't let your children wander off on their own, even for a minute.
sentences.zh: 请务必不要让孩子独自走开，哪怕只是一分钟。

sentences.text: We don't want any accidents or anyone getting frightened.
sentences.zh: 我们不希望发生任何意外，也不希望有人受到惊吓。

sentences.text: Cameras are permitted everywhere and you can take pictures of your child shooting a penalty.
sentences.zh: 相机在所有区域都允许使用，您还可以为孩子罚点球的瞬间拍照留念。

sentences.text: Assistants are helping to organise this and hopefully the queue won't be too long.
sentences.zh: 工作人员正在协助组织这项活动，希望排队时间不会太长。

sentences.text: It's very hot and sunny out on the pitch today.
sentences.zh: 今天球场外天气炎热且阳光强烈。

sentences.text: You can get food and drink at the cafe and I really recommend the healthy lunch boxes for children Also in the cafe children are invited to do a football drawing We pick the best one at the end of the afternoon so don forget to put your name and contact details on the back That way if you've left the stadium before then, we'll send your prize, but sadly we can't return drawings.
sentences.zh: 您可以在咖啡馆购买食物和饮料，我特别推荐儿童健康午餐盒。此外，在咖啡馆里，孩子们还可以参与足球主题绘画活动。我们将在下午结束时评选出最佳作品，因此请务必在画作背面写上您的姓名和联系方式。这样，即使您在结果公布前已离开体育场，我们也能将奖品寄送给您；但很遗憾，我们无法退还画作。

sentences.text: I'd like to mention some features of the tour.
sentences.zh: 我想介绍一下本次导览的一些特色。

sentences.text: We'll start with the 360 cinema experience, which has been very popular over the years, and then I'll take you to the players' dressing rooms, before going outside to the seating area and the pitch.
sentences.zh: 我们将首先体验360度影院，这一项目多年来一直广受欢迎；随后我将带大家前往球员更衣室，再走出室外，参观观众席和球场。

sentences.text: I should say, if you'd prefer your visit to be self -guided, please collect headphones from the reception, and then you can listen to the pre -recorded information at your own speed.
sentences.zh: 需要说明的是，如果您更倾向于自助导览，请在接待处领取耳机，然后您可以按照自己的节奏收听预先录制的讲解内容。

sentences.text: We've only just introduced this feature and would appreciate your feedback.
sentences.zh: 我们刚刚推出这一服务，非常期待听到您的反馈意见。

sentences.text: We're thinking of offering tours in other languages in future, so if you have any thoughts on that, we'd welcome those too.
sentences.zh: 我们正在考虑未来提供其他语言的导览服务，如果您对此有任何想法，我们也非常欢迎提出。

sentences.text: If you plan to return another time, you might like to book one of our VIP tours.
sentences.zh: 如果您计划日后再次来访，或许可以预订我们的VIP导览服务。

sentences.text: We've only just started offering these and they can be booked online.
sentences.zh: 这类导览服务我们刚刚开始提供，可在线预订。

sentences.text: While that project was going on, the team had to play its matches at the ground of another club.
sentences.zh: 在那项工程进行期间，球队不得不前往另一家俱乐部的场地进行比赛。

sentences.text: Apart from that, the club has been here on this site since 1870.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，本俱乐部自1870年起便一直坐落于此地。

sentences.text: As some of you may know, that was the start of a really important decade in the history of football in this country.
sentences.zh: 在座各位中可能有人知道，那正是我国足球史上一个极为重要的十年的开端。

sentences.text: For example, 1870 was also the year that football teams started to include a player whose role it was to guard the goal.
sentences.zh: 例如，1870年也是足球队开始配备一名专职守门员的年份，其职责是守护球门。

sentences.text: It's hard to imagine what the game must have been like without someone in that position, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 很难想象，没有这个位置时的比赛会是什么样子，对吧？

sentences.text: In 1872 and 73, man: y other clubs were established, both here and abroad.
sentences.zh: 1872年和1873年，许多其他俱乐部相继成立，不仅在本国，也在海外。

sentences.text: And the following year, in 1874, referees were allowed to send players off if they committed certain offences. and also in that year teams started having to swap ends at half-time.
sentences.zh: 次年，即1874年，裁判被允许将犯有特定犯规行为的球员罚出场；同年，球队也开始必须在中场休息时交换场地。

sentences.text: One fact I was interested to discover was that in early football games the aim was for the scorer to get the ball between two flag posts and later between sticks joined at the top with a piece of tape.
sentences.zh: 我感兴趣发现的一个事实是：早期足球比赛中，进球的目标是将球踢入两根旗杆之间，后来则改为踢入顶部由一条带子连接的两根立柱之间。

sentences.text: In 1875, that tape was replaced with the solid crossbar that we're familiar with today. 1877 saw the founding of further new clubs and the history books tell us that in the same year all the clubs decided to set a limit of 90 minutes for each match Before that it was a more casual arrangement and this sometimes caused huge arguments and sometimes fights during matches when one team called the end of the game and the other team wanted to play on to try and score a winning goal.
sentences.zh: 1875年，那条带子被我们今天所熟悉的实体横梁所取代。1877年，又有更多新俱乐部成立；历史记载显示，同年所有俱乐部一致决定将每场比赛时长限定为90分钟。在此之前，比赛时间安排较为随意，这有时会导致比赛中出现激烈争执，甚至引发斗殴——当一支球队宣布比赛结束，而另一支球队却希望继续比赛以争取打入制胜一球时。

sentences.text: By 1878, the number of teams in the Football League increased again.
sentences.zh: 到1878年，英足总联赛中的球队数量再次增加。

sentences.text: In addition, referees started using whistles and electric lamps were installed on certain pitches.
sentences.zh: 此外，裁判开始使用哨子，某些球场还安装了电灯。

sentences.text: This was a significant change, as games could then be played in the evenings all year round.
sentences.zh: 这是一项重大变革，因为此后比赛全年都可在晚间进行。

sentences.text: In 1880, clubs began to charge fans for admission to games, even though players were still amateurs and had other proper jobs.
sentences.zh: 1880年，各俱乐部开始向观众收取观赛入场费，尽管当时球员仍属业余身份，另有正式职业。

sentences.text: That's hard to imagine in the modern professional game. where top players earn significant sums of money from both playing and commercial activities.
sentences.zh: 在当今职业化程度极高的现代足球中，这确实令人难以想象——顶级球员仅靠踢球和商业活动便能获得巨额收入。

sentences.text: MAN: How are you getting on with the assignment on handwriting?
sentences.zh: MAN: 你在手写作业方面进展如何？

sentences.text: WOMAN: Not too bad.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 还不错。

sentences.text: You know, I hadn't realised that children benefit in so man: y ways from learning to write.
sentences.zh: 你知道吗，我之前没意识到，儿童从学习书写中能在如此多方面获益。

sentences.text: It's such an important skill, and yet most people think handwriting is less important than in the past, because people hardly ever write by hand these days.
sentences.zh: 这是一项非常重要的技能，然而大多数人认为，与过去相比，手写已不那么重要了，因为如今人们几乎不再用手写字了。

sentences.text: MAN: Yes, and all the evidence suggests children should learn to write by hand before they learn to type, not least because it helps their memory.
sentences.zh: MAN: 是的，而且所有证据都表明，儿童应在学习打字之前先学习手写，这至少有助于增强他们的记忆力。

sentences.text: WOMAN: That's right.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 没错。

sentences.text: The physical act of writing helps children to remember letters.
sentences.zh: 书写的肢体动作有助于儿童记忆字母。

sentences.text: That seems pretty obvious when you think about it.
sentences.zh: 你仔细一想，这点似乎相当明显。

sentences.text: MAN: What's less obvious is how it helps dev: elop their concentration.
sentences.zh: MAN: 不太明显的是，它如何帮助发展儿童的专注力。

sentences.text: They have to sit still and focus on one thing.
sentences.zh: 他们必须静坐不动，并专注于一件事。

sentences.text: WOMAN: Yeah, that aspect of handwriting had never occurred to me before.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是啊，手写的这一方面我以前从未想过。

sentences.text: MAN: Same here.
sentences.zh: MAN: 我也是。

sentences.text: I'm not sure I understand how it improves children's imagination, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，我不太明白它究竟如何提升儿童的想象力。

sentences.text: WOMAN: Well there was that study which showed that primary age children generated more ideas when they were writing by hand than using a keyboard I would have guessed that would be the case
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 嗯，曾有一项研究显示，小学阶段的儿童用手写时比用键盘输入时能产生更多创意点子。我本来也猜会是这样。

sentences.text: MAN: Hmm yeah I never associated spatial awareness with handwriting either.
sentences.zh: MAN: 嗯，是啊，我也从未将空间感知能力与手写联系起来。

sentences.text: I thought spatial awareness was more to do with knowing where you are in relation to objects or other people.
sentences.zh: 我以为空间感知能力更多是指了解自己相对于物体或其他人的位置。

sentences.text: WOMAN: I thought that too.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 我以前也是这么想的。

sentences.text: But good spatial awareness is essential for writing because you have to space words correctly.
sentences.zh: 但良好的空间感知能力对于书写至关重要，因为你必须正确安排单词之间的间距。

sentences.text: It's not just fine motor skills that improve through writing, as I'd always assumed.
sentences.zh: 通过书写所提升的，不仅仅是精细运动技能——这是我过去一直以为的。

sentences.text: MAN: Handwriting is so much harder for children with dyspraxia, who have problems coordinating movement.
sentences.zh: MAN: 对于患有发育性协调障碍（dyspraxia）的儿童而言，手写要困难得多，因为他们存在动作协调方面的困难。

sentences.text: It's good there are lots of things you can do in the classroom to help them.
sentences.zh: classroom里有很多事情可以做来帮助他们，这很好。

sentences.text: They need so much more support with letter formation.
sentences.zh: 他们在字母书写方面需要更多的支持。

sentences.text: You need to play lots of games to help them distinguish letter shapes.
sentences.zh: 你需要玩很多游戏来帮助他们区分字母的形状。

sentences.text: It takes a lot of patience.
sentences.zh: 这需要极大的耐心。

sentences.text: WOMAN: Yeah, I like the idea of using one of those pens that lights up if you press too hard.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是的，我喜欢使用那种按压力度过大时会亮灯的笔的想法。

sentences.text: That seems like a really simple solution.
sentences.zh: 这似乎是一个非常简单的解决方案。

sentences.text: MAN: Yes, absolutely.
sentences.zh: MAN: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.text: I'm not sure there's much you can do about children with dyspraxia writing very slowly.
sentences.zh: 我不确定对于书写速度非常慢的发育性协调障碍儿童，能做些什么。

sentences.text: It's more important to focus on accuracy and as they get more confident, I think they eventually speed up.
sentences.zh: 更重要的是关注书写的准确性；随着他们自信心增强，我认为最终书写速度会提高。

sentences.text: WOMAN: One quite simple thing you can do is to use grid paper.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 你可以做的一个相当简单的方法是使用方格纸。

sentences.text: So they write each letter in a box and that trains them to space the letters correctly.
sentences.zh: 这样他们每个字母都写在一个方格内，从而训练他们正确地间隔字母。

sentences.text: MAN: Indeed, that's more important for legibility than trying to get them to write in a straight line.
sentences.zh: MAN: 的确，这对书写的清晰度比强迫他们沿直线书写更为重要。

sentences.text: MAN: For some children, it might be better to teach them to write on a laptop rather than by hand, like children with dyslexia.
sentences.zh: MAN: 对某些儿童而言，教他们用笔记本电脑写字而非手写可能更好，比如患有阅读障碍的儿童。

sentences.text: They often really struggle with handwriting and some just give up.
sentences.zh: 他们常常在书写方面遇到很大困难，有些孩子甚至干脆放弃。

sentences.text: WOMAN: Yeah, it's not as frustrating for them if they get things wrong.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是的，如果写错了，对他们来说不会那么沮丧。

sentences.text: On a keyboard, they can be more willing to have a go.
sentences.zh: 在键盘上，他们更愿意尝试。

sentences.text: But I read that dev: eloping fluency isn't any faster.
sentences.zh: 但我读到过，发展书写流利度并不会因此更快。

sentences.text: MAN: That's right.
sentences.zh: MAN: 没错。

sentences.text: Did you read that article on the benefits of teaching print rather than cursive handwriting, where the letters are joined up?
sentences.zh: 你读过那篇关于教授印刷体而非连笔字（即字母相连的书写方式）益处的文章吗？

sentences.text: WOMAN: Yes.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 读过了。

sentences.text: Well, in the past, cursive writing was certainly considered more stylish and educated, but not anymore.
sentences.zh: 过去，草书书写当然被认为更时尚、更有教养，但如今已不再如此。

sentences.text: Teachers' attitudes have changed because it's been proved that cursive is more difficult to learn, especially for children with learning difficulties who find joining up letters really challenging.
sentences.zh: 教师的态度发生了变化，因为已有研究表明，草书更难学习，尤其是对有学习障碍的儿童而言，连笔写字对他们来说极具挑战性。

sentences.text: MAN: I agree.
sentences.zh: MAN: 我同意。

sentences.text: I was always worried that my poor handwriting affected my exam results, and now research shows that I was right to worry.
sentences.zh: 我过去一直担心自己糟糕的字迹会影响考试成绩，而如今的研究表明，我当时担心得完全正确。

sentences.text: I'm sure a lot of students think it's unfair that they're being judged on their handwriting, not just their knowledge.
sentences.zh: 我确信许多学生认为，仅凭字迹而非知识水平来评判他们，这是不公平的。

sentences.text: WOMAN: Marks are definitely affected if examiners can read the script.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 如果考官能读懂考生的卷面字迹，分数确实会受到影响。

sentences.text: That is why it has always been so important to teach children to write legibly.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，教会孩子书写清晰一直显得尤为重要。

sentences.text: Do you think the role of handwriting will change in the future
sentences.zh: 您认为手写的作用在未来会发生变化吗？

sentences.text: MAN: I can't see that changing much.
sentences.zh: MAN: 我看不出这会有太大改变。

sentences.text: Touch typing still isn't taught in most schools, which is a shame.
sentences.zh: 目前大多数学校仍未开设触键打字课程，这实在令人遗憾。

sentences.text: But maybe that won't be necessary in the future, because people will also be able to write by hand on digital dev: ices.
sentences.zh: 但未来或许不再需要专门学习打字，因为人们将能在数字设备上直接手写输入。

sentences.text: Anyway, teachers understand the value of handwriting.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，教师们深知手写的价值。

sentences.text: It's a basic life skill.
sentences.zh: 这是一种基本的生活技能。

sentences.text: WOMAN: True.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 没错。

sentences.text: However, the fact is that people are writing by hand less and less and relying on digital
sentences.zh: 然而事实是，人们手写的次数正变得越来越少，越来越依赖数字设备。

sentences.text: DEV: ices.
sentences.zh: DEV: 设备。

sentences.text: That does cause some problems.
sentences.zh: 这确实引发了一些问题。

sentences.text: MAN: You mean like note-taking.
sentences.zh: MAN: 您是指记笔记这类情况吧。

sentences.text: There are lots of apps for that.
sentences.zh: 现在有许多专门用于记笔记的应用程序。

sentences.text: WOMAN: And for reading historical documents, apparently.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 据说，阅读历史文献时也需要手写能力。

sentences.text: But my mum is shocked by my awful spelling and the fact that my punctuation is really inconsistent.
sentences.zh: 但我的妈妈对我的糟糕拼写和标点符号使用极不一致感到震惊。

sentences.text: I think you can put that down to lack of practice.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这可以归因于缺乏练习。

sentences.text: MAN: I expect so.
sentences.zh: MAN: 我想确实如此。

sentences.text: Personally, I miss writing by hand.
sentences.zh: 就我个人而言，我很怀念手写的感觉。

sentences.text: I hardly ever write anything now.
sentences.zh: 我现在几乎从不手写任何东西了。

sentences.text: I remember my grandparents had such beautiful handwriting and it was so individual.
sentences.zh: 我记得我祖父母的字迹非常漂亮，而且极具个人特色。

sentences.text: Nobody I know would be able to identify my handwriting now.
sentences.zh: 现在我认识的人中，没人能辨认出我的字迹。

sentences.text: It's a shame.
sentences.zh: 真是可惜。

sentences.text: WOMAN: I know.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 我知道。

sentences.text: I feel the same way.
sentences.zh: 我也有同感。

sentences.text: I used to write a diary by hand and now I do that digitally.
sentences.zh: 我过去习惯手写日记，而现在则改用数字方式记录。

sentences.text: It just seems less effort to do it that way.
sentences.zh: 这样似乎更省力一些。

sentences.text: So it's not just a problem...
sentences.zh: 所以这并不仅仅是一个问题……

sentences.text: We've been looking at different types of conflicts that may arise between wildlife and humans at the boundaries of protected areas, such as national parks and animal sanctuaries.
sentences.zh: We一直在研究在保护区（例如国家公园和动物庇护所）边界处可能发生的野生动物与人类之间的各种冲突。

sentences.text: I'd like to illustrate this by telling you about some research that I've been involved in recently in the Central African country of Zambia in the area around the Chembe Bird Sanctuary which contains over 300 of the listed birds of Zambia These include a number of birds of prey such as eagles hawks and owls that live by hunting and killing other birds and animals Now most of the people living in the local communities near to the bird sanctuary are small - scale farmers and these birds of prey provide important social and ecological benefits to them.
sentences.zh: 我想通过介绍我最近在中非国家赞比亚的钦贝鸟类庇护所周边地区参与的一项研究来说明这一点。该庇护所内栖息着超过300种被列入赞比亚鸟类名录的鸟类，其中包括多种猛禽，例如鹰、隼和猫头鹰，它们依靠捕猎并杀死其他鸟类和动物为生。目前，生活在鸟类庇护所附近当地社区的居民大多为小规模农户，而这些猛禽为他们提供了重要的社会与生态效益。

sentences.text: For example, a lot of damage can be caused to farmers' crops by rodents, such as rats, which would consume the crops as they grow in the fields, as well as after harvesting if they weren't hunted and killed by the birds.
sentences.zh: 例如，啮齿类动物（如老鼠）会对农民的农作物造成严重损害：它们不仅在庄稼于田间生长期间啃食作物，而且若未被鸟类捕杀，还会在收获后继续破坏农产品。

sentences.text: And the predatory habits of these birds also protect farmers in other ways.
sentences.zh: 此外，这些鸟类的捕食习性还以其他方式保护着农民。

sentences.text: For example, a major danger to rural workers is snakes, whose bite may be dangerous or even fatal, and birds of prey have a major role in keeping their populations under control.
sentences.zh: 例如，蛇对农村劳动者构成重大威胁，其咬伤可能具有危险性甚至致命；而猛禽在控制蛇类种群数量方面发挥着重要作用。

sentences.text: Local people have always been aware of these benefits and for years, even before the sanctuary was opened in 1973, the birds played a key role in the culture of the region.
sentences.zh: 当地人一直清楚这些益处；事实上，在1973年该庇护所建立之前多年，这些鸟类便已在本地区的文化中扮演关键角色。

sentences.text: However, more recently, the sanctuary and its birds have also become increasingly important to the community in economic terms, because at present, after a relatively slow start, tourism has become an important source of revenue for them.
sentences.zh: 然而，近年来，该庇护所及其鸟类在经济层面也日益成为社区的重要资源：目前，在经历了一段相对缓慢的发展初期后，旅游业已成为当地一项重要收入来源。

sentences.text: However, although these birds of prey are protected by the government, their numbers are falling.
sentences.zh: 不过，尽管这些猛禽受到政府保护，其数量却正在减少。

sentences.text: Some of these deaths are accidental.
sentences.zh: 其中一些死亡属于意外事故。

sentences.text: Fatalities occur when birds alight on roads to catch and eat their prey, and are hit by fast moving traffic.
sentences.zh: 当猛禽降落在道路上捕捉并食用猎物时，会被高速行驶的车辆撞死。

sentences.text: Drivers in Zambia have to take special care at night, as birds may regard the quieter roads as safe places to sleep.
sentences.zh: 赞比亚的司机夜间行车时必须格外小心，因为鸟类可能将较为安静的道路视为安全的休憩场所。

sentences.text: Accidental deaths may also occur if these birds fly close to high power lines as they may be electrocuted This is a particular danger in the heavy rain which can occur in the region in the months from December to April And local farmers also pose a threat to these birds.
sentences.zh: 若这些猛禽在飞行过程中过于靠近高压输电线，也可能发生意外死亡——它们可能触电身亡。这一风险在每年12月至4月该地区常出现的强降雨期间尤为突出。此外，当地农民也对这些猛禽构成威胁。

sentences.text: As well as growing crops, small -scale farmers in the area also rear chickens.
sentences.zh: 除种植农作物外，该地区的小规模农户还饲养鸡只。

sentences.text: These provide food for the farmers' families, as well as being an important source of income.
sentences.zh: 鸡只为农户家庭提供食物，同时也是重要的收入来源。

sentences.text: But they're also an easy target for birds of prey, and so farmers may shoot these birds, which is illegal but understandable, or they may poison the birds, which again is illegal and can have negative effects on the ecosystem.
sentences.zh: 但鸡只也极易成为猛禽的捕食目标，因此农民可能会射杀这些猛禽——此举虽属违法却情有可原；或者投毒杀害猛禽——此举同样违法，并会对生态系统产生负面影响。

sentences.text: So how else can farmers protect their chickens from birds of prey?
sentences.zh: 那么，农民还能采取哪些其他方法来保护鸡只免受猛禽侵害呢？

sentences.text: Some people believe that to prevent the predators from settling near the area where the chickens are kept, it's best to keep this area free from vegetation.
sentences.zh: 一些人认为，为防止猛禽在鸡只饲养区附近栖息，最佳做法是清除该区域的所有植被。

sentences.text: But in fact, this is counterproductive, as it means the chickens have no cover to hide in and they'll be easier for the birds to see.
sentences.zh: 但事实上，这种做法适得其反，因为这意味着鸡只失去可供藏身的遮蔽物，反而更容易被猛禽发现。

sentences.text: Another possibility would be to prevent the chickens from going outside at all and to keep them safe from predators inside a building, but this would cost far too much to be a practical solution.
sentences.zh: 另一种可能性是完全禁止鸡只外出，将其全部关在建筑物内以躲避天敌，但这种方法成本过高，不具备实际可行性。

sentences.text: Nearly all the farmers reported that they spent a lot of time and effort trying to frighten off the birds of prey without actually harming them.
sentences.zh: 几乎所有受访农户均表示，他们花费大量时间与精力，试图在不伤害猛禽的前提下驱赶它们。

sentences.text: Most of the farmers had at least one dog and said this was a big help at scaring away the predators.
sentences.zh: 大多数农民至少养了一只狗，称这在驱赶捕食者方面帮助很大。

sentences.text: Some of the farmers also reported that during the breeding season, when the chickens were particularly vulnerable, they encouraged their children to watch over the chickens and to hit pans with a metal spoon so that the resulting noise would succeed in driving away birds that were trying to seize the young chicks None of these methods was 100 effective so as a result the village people told us that rather than just using one method, they were forced to use a combination for them to have any effect.
sentences.zh: 一些农民还报告称，在繁殖季节，当鸡特别脆弱时，他们会鼓励孩子照看鸡群，并用金属勺敲击锅具，由此产生的噪音成功驱走了试图捕捉小鸡的鸟类。这些方法没有一种是百分之百有效的，因此村民们告诉我们，他们不得不将多种方法结合起来使用，才能产生任何效果。

sentences.text: And even so, these birds of prey remain a major threat to the chickens' survival and cause considerable economic loss to farmers.
sentences.zh: 即便如此，这些猛禽仍是鸡生存的主要威胁，并给农民造成相当可观的经济损失。

sentences.text: So we looked at the possibility of a longer-term solution to...
sentences.zh: 因此，我们研究了长期解决方案的可能性……
